body_html:
Pastor Daniel Whyte III shares this one-minute Gospel prayer devotional from the Daniel Whyte III Evangelistic Association.

The Daniel Whyte III Evangelistic Association's purpose is to proclaim the Gospel to all people by any means necessary. Pray for us and join us in obeying the Great Commission and the Great Commandment given by Jesus Christ.

Watch the one-minute Gospel prayer devotional on Facebook
summary: Pastor Daniel Whyte III shares a one-minute Gospel prayer devotional from the Daniel Whyte III Evangelistic Association: proclaiming the Gospel to all people by any means necessary, and calling believers to obey the Great Commission and the Great Commandment.
title: One-Minute Gospel Prayer Devotional From Daniel Whyte III
